title: Prepare Uric Acid Solution
author: 宏亮 董
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7cjhiun
materials: Prepare Borate Buffer Storage Solution : Add these reagents to a clean media bottle, DDW volume to 200ml, adjust pH to 8.5 with NaOH.

steps.title: Prepare Uric Acid Diluent Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the diluent solution by mixing distilled water and borate buffer, then adjusting the pH.

substeps.instruction: Add 152 mL DDW and 8 mL Borate Buffer Storage Solution to a clean media bottle.

steps.title: Prepare Uric Acid Storage Solution
steps.instruction: Create a storage solution by dissolving uric acid in the previously prepared diluent.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve the uric acid in Uric Acid Diluent Solution and dilute to a final volume of 100mL.

steps.title: Prepare Uric Acid Working Solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the storage solution to create a working solution, adjusting concentration as needed for the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Dilute Uric Acid Storage Solution with Uric Acid Diluent Solution 10 times.
